name: prompt-mode-edit
description: `freecode -p "<prompt>" --edit` runs the same headless turn with the write half of the registry offered instead of a read-only set. The assertion that matters is the tool set the model was handed: read/grep/list_dir plus create/edit/shell_exec present, spawn_agent still absent - editing is not fan-out, and an unattended turn must not spend whole sub-turns. The write really lands (files checks note.txt), and it lands without an approval prompt, which is what auto ask-mode means once writes are on the table. The stdout contract is unchanged from prompt-mode: only the final answer, no tool chrome
